purpose: Durable public-safe engineering evidence for reference-template eligibility. These labels are not machine-learning targets.

GEN_B8_01.wav.diagnosis: Successful control: stable source section and predictable repeated-hook/motif context support the loop-build entry.

GEN_B8_02.wav.diagnosis: Target connection and effect worked; source release began inside an active lyric and an unstable verse-to-outro source window.

GEN_C3_01.wav.diagnosis: Successful control with close tempo/groove, sparse source arrangement, and non-dominant vocal stem.

GEN_C3_02.wav.diagnosis: No single renderer defect; near-limit stretch, larger groove distance, dense source arrangement, and dominant vocal compound.

GEN_D2_01.wav.diagnosis: Long overlap should reject weak global harmonic compatibility plus excessive combined arrangement density.

GEN_D2_02.wav.diagnosis: More compatible key relationship and lower shared density preserve room for a restrained ownership blend.

GEN_F_01.wav.diagnosis: Reset/repetition begins inside a long continuing vocal unit rather than after a self-contained motif.

GEN_F_02.wav.diagnosis: Better pair, but the selected release still occurs at high vocal level inside an incomplete lyric unit.

GEN_B8_02_FIX.wav.change: Move source phrase 40 beats earlier so release begins on a vocal phrase tail and the loop starts in instrumental space; apply an equal-power source-to-loop entry only during bars 4.00-4.22. Target anchors, gain, components, reveal, timing map, tail, and establishment are unchanged.

GEN_F_02_FIX.wav.change: Move the four-bar source phrase 12 beats earlier to a downbeat vocal gap after one self-contained unit. Target anchors, natural adjacent target samples, gain, reset envelope, and choreography are unchanged.

eligibility_rules.reset_release: Require capturable final-bar material and release within 0.75 seconds of its vocal-unit boundary; search other downbeat-aligned four-bar windows or return NOT SUITABLE.
eligibility_rules.loop_build_coherent_handoff: Prefer instrumental space or a phrase-end release whose loop starts in a vocal gap. Active-vocal entry requires stable-section, high motif-context similarity indicating a predictable repeated hook. Preserve phrase duration when relocating the cue.
eligibility_rules.stem_echo_handoff: Dense source arrangement combined with greater than 8 percent stretch and groove distance above 0.18 is explicitly borderline.
eligibility_rules.restrained_ownership_blend: Reject global harmonic compatibility below 0.50 or combined source/target arrangement-density pressure above 1.65.

gate: Human listening of GEN_B8_02_FIX.wav and GEN_F_02_FIX.wav. No C3 or D2 fix was rendered.
